apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

patent-proceeding.eventDescription: One USPTO PTAB trial or EPO opposition-related legal event delivered to the dataset.

clinical-record.eventDescription: One new or changed ClinicalTrials.gov study or FDA Orange Book record delivered.

uae-entity-new.eventDescription: An ADGM or DIFC registration never delivered before.

uae-entity-updated.eventDescription: A previously delivered ADGM/DIFC entity whose status or content changed.

sg-entity-new.eventDescription: An ACRA-registered entity never delivered before.

sg-entity-updated.eventDescription: A previously delivered ACRA entity whose status or content changed.

watchlist-hit.eventDescription: Charged once for each delivered corporate or patent record whose text matches a keyword of the caller's own watchlist. Never charged when no valid keyword was supplied.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: Consolidation of single-source Actors into global-corporate-patent-intelligence: each legacy source keeps its own per-record price as a separate event, and the start event is set to $0.005.
